title: SKERNEL configuration
description: The settings of a project for SKERNEL's commands, read from skernel.json or skernel.json.dist in the project root. A setting left out keeps its default.

$schema.description: The schema that describes this file.

php.description: The managed PHP version: major.minor for that branch's latest release, or an exact major.minor.patch; by default the latest release that the root package's require.php allows.

prebuilt.description: Whether a managed PHP that is missing from the SKERNEL home may be downloaded prebuilt from the SKERNEL runtimes repository instead of being built on this machine; false always builds it here.

composer.description: The Composer that build, run, and package use: a path, relative to the project root when it contains a /, or a name looked up in PATH; by default the first working Composer 2 or else SKERNEL's own.

watch.description: Whether run rebuilds and restarts the application when a watched file changes.

watch-files.description: The name patterns of the watched files, with *, ?, and [...]; the vendor directory, target/, and directories whose name starts with a dot are never watched.

runtime.description: A micro.sfx that replaces the managed micro runtime, relative to the project root.

output.description: The package path, relative to the project root; by default target/<name>, or target/<name>.phar for a PHAR.

dev.description: Whether the development dependencies are installed into the package.

phar.description: Whether packaging stops at the PHAR instead of a standalone binary.
